links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: Construction fits every criterion except the one that matters commercially
content:
The assessment records construction as sufficiently decentralized with standardization, with "BIM / IFC as the primary symptoms", able to help establish PMF, holding companion software in the IFC ecosystem and Speckle, and with Powerhouse "well connected". Then: "lacks established consultancy market".

That single miss is decisive under the stated criteria, because the whole revenue path runs through consultancies as the channel. Strong technical fit plus existing relationships does not compensate for having no one to sell through.

It is the clearest illustration of why the criteria are a conjunction rather than a score. A weighted ranking would likely have placed construction first.
description: Decentralized, standardized on BIM/IFC, has companion software in the IFC ecosystem and Speckle, and Powerhouse is well connected there — but it lacks an established consultancy market.
